_comment: Models packed by tools/build-ai-pack.ps1. One entry per AiPackComponent (Quill.Core/Ports/AiPack.cs).
path: location inside the ai-pack folder, written to ai-pack.json 'files'.
volume: 'main' -> quill-ai-pack-<version>.zip (holds ai-pack.json); any other name -> quill-ai-pack-<version>-<volume>.zip.
Every volume must stay under 2 GiB, so no single model file may reach 2 GiB either.
LLM: Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M (F0's scored model) is 2.33 GiB and cannot be a GitHub asset; UD-Q3_K_XL (1.98 GiB) is the largest Qwen3-4B quant that fits.
sha256: pinned lowercase hex, or TO_FILL_ON_FIRST_BUILD to print the hash and refuse to package without -AcceptNewHashes.
size: exact bytes, or 0 when unknown (then only maxBytes bounds the download).
url: HTTPS on huggingface.co or github.com, pinned to a commit where the host supports it.
